findings.source_quote: Esther was a very gentle, sweet girl, which is mostly what Hadassah remembered her for.
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha tafsiri iwe sahihi na isiyokinzana: mfano, "Esther alikuwa msichana mpole sana na mtamu, ndipo Hadassah alivyomkumbuka zaidi."
findings.translation_quote: Esther alikuwa msichana mlevi sana na mtamu, ndivyo ambavyo Hadassah alikumbuka zaidi kumhusu.

findings.source_quote: She was sure that Hadassah had stolen it.
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri kwa uwazi kuwa mleviwa au alidai kuiba: mfano, "Alikuwa na hakika kuwa Hadassah alikuwa ameiba." (si "alimwindikia").

findings.source_quote: At the next recess she was blamed for cheating on her flash cards.
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri "cheating" kwa usahihi (si "stealing"). Mfano: "Wakati wa mapumziko uliofuata alishtakiwa kwa udanganyifu wakati akitumia kadi zake za kujifunzia (flash cards)."
findings.translation_quote: Wakati wa mapumziko uliofuata alishtakiwa kwa kuibiwa kwa karatasi zake za kufundishia.

findings.source_quote: She taught the girls a song, “How Far Is Heaven”, which Hadassah still likes to sing today!
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri wimbo uliotajwa kwa maandishi yaliyoweza kusomwa kwa Kiswahili au nilete tafsiri ya kichwa cha wimbo ndani ya alama za nukuu. Mfano: "Alimfundisha kundi wimbo, ‘Je Mbinguni ni Mbali Ngapi?’, ambao Hadassah bado anapenda kuimba hadi leo!" (badilisha awamu za maneno kama inavyofaa kwa Kiswahili).
findings.translation_quote: Lakini alimfundisha kundi wimbo, “How Far Is Heaven”, ambao Hadassah bado anapenda kuimba hadi leo!

findings.source_quote: An ambulance driving with its emergency lights on
findings.suggested_fix: Sahihisha alt ili kukadiria maana ya asili: mfano, "Gari la wagonjwa likiendesha na taa zake za dharura zikiwa zimetamkwa/on"; katika Kiswahili sahihi: "Gari la wagonjwa likiendeshwa litukayo na taa zake za dharura zikiwa zimeteweka/zinawaka." (tumia "zinawaka" au "zikizua mwanga" sio "zikizima").
findings.translation_quote: Gari la wagonjwa likiendesha na taa zake za dharura zikizima

findings.source_quote: As a child, you might think you can’t make a difference in the lives of people around you, but that is not true!
findings.suggested_fix: Tumia kifrazia cha Kiswahili sanifu au idiom inayofaa: mfano, "Unapokuwa mtoto, unaweza kufikiri huwezi kuleta tofauti..." badala ya "Ukitoka utotoni".
findings.translation_quote: Ukitoka utotoni, unaweza kudhani hauwezi kuleta tofauti katika maisha ya watu waliokuzunguka, lakini hiyo si kweli!

findings.source_quote: the second-grade girls were ready for someone to be mean to, or so it seemed.
findings.suggested_fix: Tafsiri kwa ufasaha: mfano, "wasichana wa darasa la pili walionekana kuwa tayari kumdhuru au kumdhulumu mtu." Epuka maneno yasiyo ya kawaida kama "mkasiriwa."
findings.translation_quote: wasichana wa darasa la pili walikuwa tayari kumchukulia mtu wa kuwa mkasiriwa, au hivyo ilionekana.
